title: Independent progressive preview delivery and optional reduced reconstruction

definition.hypothesis: Reduce unnecessary temporal/spatial work and optionally deliver an early preview, without requiring a universal custom decoder or altering playback state.
definition.scope_contract: Declared requested versus represented timestamp and spatial fidelity; independent preview operation; synthetic native components only in this run; no whole-player or hardware claims.
definition.baseline: Use existing authored/cached images where appropriate. For source extraction use optimized independent full decode plus resize at the same represented timestamp/quality. Full-file decode-and-select is only an exploratory sweep comparison, not the best hover baseline.
definition.success_criteria: A bounded screen distinguishes viable paths, actual unsupported mechanisms and untested integration. Local performance thresholds must be declared before new timing; this run has no retroactive formal benefit pass.
definition.stop_criteria: Actual mechanism absent, output contract fails, complete cost does not beat the best existing qualified provider, or maintenance/contended playback cost exceeds targeted benefit.
definition.primary_metric: First usable preview latency at declared time accuracy/quality; total work, resource retention and playback interference separately.
definition.negative_control: Unsupported lowres dimensions, VP9 ignored keyframe skipping, loop-filter output changes, and algebraic DC-only boundary mismatch.
definition.effort_limit: Current source/native component screen ends here. Next: one focused browser baseline session before any custom full-decoder work; then separately timebox a narrow prototype.

define.basis: Bounded mechanism and output contract recorded; no canonical R-number allocated.

prepare.basis: Native synthetic fixtures, tools, references, scripts and evidence prepared. Browser setup remains separately blocked.

screen.basis: Seven native component screens completed, including meaningful negatives. This is not a universal candidate pass.

correctness.basis: Only scoped component output checks passed. No complete partial video decoder or Demuxe lifecycle/provider correctness has been executed.

performance.basis: Exploratory native timings retained; no predeclared full-provider benefit gate or browser/hardware qualification.

results.basis: Commands, raw trials, negatives, limitations and source/fixture hashes captured.

decision.basis: Scoped pursue/stop/inconclusive/blocked choices recorded; integration is separate.

record.reason: Pursue independent tiered preview delivery; keep custom video reconstruction optional, gated and removable. Individual path decisions and browser block are recorded separately.
record.scope: Native synthetic component screen, not integrated browser preview qualification.

next_action: Resolve current canonical full keys and follow LOCAL_AGENT.md: browser best-baseline first, selective decoder only if a reconstruction bottleneck remains.
